data.title: 神罚 · 晨光厨房的露肩毛衣早安
data.description: 阳光温暖的公寓厨房内，吐司面包在烤面包机中弹起。神罚穿着浅灰色的露肩罗纹针织短裙，长袖盖住大半手背。她双手捧着印着爱心的马克杯转过身，深红色的眼眸倒映着晨曦，嘴角泛着甜美满足的纯真微笑，像等待夸奖的初恋女友般向你小步跑来。
data.location: cozy modern kitchen with sunlit breakfast bar and pastel decor
data.action: holding warm mug with both hands, off-shoulder grey knit sweater dress slipping slightly, turning with radiant pure smile, bright sunbeam on hair
data.lighting: pure bright morning sunlight pouring through kitchen glass
data.mood: blissful domestic morning sweetness, heart-melting innocent devotion
data.promptProse: Standing in a sun-drenched modern kitchen, Modernia holds a steaming mug with both hands. Her off-shoulder grey knit dress slips softly over bare collarbones as she beams with radiant, innocent affection in the morning light.
data.animaCaption: Modernia in an off-shoulder knit dress holding a mug in a sunlit kitchen, smiling radiantly.
